PGHOST.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service (private domain). The entrypoint composes DATABASE_URL from this and the other PG* vars.

PGPORT.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service (private port).

PGUSER.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service.

PGPASSWORD.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service.

PGDATABASE.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string, auto-composed from the companion postgres service variables. Do not hardcode credentials.

JWT_SECRET.description: REQUIRED — a random string used to sign JWT tokens. This placeholder auto-generates one for you. Do not reuse an existing secret.

ALLOW_REGISTER.description: Optional — whether to allow new user registration. Set to 'true' to allow sign-ups, 'false' (default) to disable after initial setup.

ALLOW_OPENAPI.description: Optional — whether to expose the OpenAPI documentation endpoint. Defaults to 'true'.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional — the public URL of this Tianji instance. Auto-filled from the service's public domain. Override if using a custom domain.

WEBSITE_ID.description: Optional — UUID of a pre-created website to track this Tianji instance itself. Leave empty to skip self-tracking.

JWT_ISSUER.description: Optional — JWT issuer claim. Defaults to 'tianji.msgbyte.com' if empty.

JWT_AUDIENCE.description: Optional — JWT audience claim. Defaults to 'msgbyte.com' if empty.

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: Optional — ClickHouse connection URL for analytics storage. Leave empty to use the default PostgreSQL-backed analytics.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: Optional — ClickHouse username. Only used when CLICKHOUSE_URL is set.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: Optional — ClickHouse password. Only used when CLICKHOUSE_URL is set.

CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.description: Optional — ClickHouse database name. Only used when CLICKHOUSE_URL is set.
